ARTICLE PREMIER. GENERALITES 
Dans le cadre du renforcement et du développement des équipements dédiés à la recherche scientifique 
au sein de l’Université de Mayotte, il est prévu d’acquérir un drone équipé d’un capteur bathymétrique 
de haute précision. Cet équipement viendra compléter les instruments de mesure déjà opérationnels et 
contribuera à élargir significativement les capacités d’étude, de surveillance et d’observation des milieux 
marins. 
L’intégration de cette technologie de bathymétrie permettra la réalisation de relevés détaillés des fonds 
marins ainsi que la production de modèles 3D précis de la topographie sous -marine. Ce nouvel outil 
constituera un apport déterminant pour les travaux de recherche, les missions de suivi environnemental 
et le développement de projets scientifiques innovants portés par l’université. 
Ces équipements renforceront la position de l’Université de Mayotte en tant qu’acteur régional majeur 
de la recherche scientifique, tout en affirmant son engagement en faveur de la préservation de 
l’environnement et de l’étude approfondie des écosystèmes de l’océan Indien.

bathymétrie LiDAR aéroportée par drone. Le titulaire garantit la compatibilité et l’intégration 
fonctionnelle de l’ensemble des composants proposés, notamment le drone, le capteur bathymétrique, 
le système GNSS/INS, le système de fixation et d ’intégration, les accessoires, les logiciels nécessaires à 
l’acquisition et au traitement des données, ainsi que leur mise en service.

drone ;

description-proc.eng: Background Troms County, c/o the FORREGION Troms section development and innovation, needs external assistance with research mobilisation in business. The aim is to strengthen the link between companies and relevant research and development environments and contribute to having several entities in Troms initiate research and innovation projects. FORREGION is responsible for research based innovation in the regions and is a subsidy scheme aimed at companies with little or no experience with research and development work. The procurement shall support the scheme's aim of increasing the share of R&D in business through mobilisation, closer connection between businesses and R&D environments and that preliminary projects to a greater degree lead on to main projects and other continued research activity. The procurement will be implemented as the county needs capacity and expertise to work systematically, outreach and needs managed towards companies, particularly small and medium sized entities who have little experience with research and development. At the same time, there is a need to make relevant R&D environments, financing schemes and other means more accessible for businesses in the region. The assignment shall support the aim of increased research efforts in business, several qualified applications for relevant research resources and better regional coverage in the mobilisation work. It is particularly important to mobilise research-independent companies in prioritised branches, facilitate more lasting co-operation relationships between businesses and R&D actors and contribute to the continuation of promising initiatives from early idea phases and preliminary projects to major development and research projects. Description of the assignment The contracting authority shall procure assistance from a total of five competence broker teams for research mobilisation in Troms. The resources shall collectively cover the topic areas seafood, space activity/space, KI and technology development as well as Circular Troms, where two of the sub-contracts shall be related to seafood. Each sub-contract shall be taken care of by a competence broker team with relevant and complementary competence within the relevant input area. The target group for the assignment is small and medium sized companies that belong to Troms county, or who have considerable activity in Troms. Competence brokering shall be a free offer to the target group. The assignment requires that the competence brokers act independently and neutrally and that they do not represent business actors who can be in a competitive relationship with the companies that receive assistance. The competence brokers shall sign a confidentiality statement. The delivery includes outreach contact with companies, needs analysis, mapping of relevant R&D partners, connection between companies and research environments as well as guidance in the development of R&D projects and applications for research resources. Follow-up shall be adapted to each company's need and maturity, and can include assistance from early idea clarification and preliminary project for further mobilisation with main projects and other relevant schemes. The competence broker shall be a consultant and supervisor in application processes, but shall not write applications on behalf of the companies or act in competition with private actors. The competence broker teams shall be able to identify the companies ́ need for research and innovation, contribute to finding relevant research competence and guide the companies towards appropriate sources of financing. This includes FORREGION and other relevant schemes, e.g. Tax Finds, The Research Council of Norway, Innovation Norway, Horizon Europe and other relevant means. Where it is natural, the competence brokers should also refer to other actors in the funding apparatus. The assignment includes further follow-up of companies that have previously carried out preliminary projects financed by FORREGION Troms, with the aim of contributing to further development and execution of main projects. The competence brokers shall also be able to arrange network meetings between businesses and R&D actors in order to identify common problems, possibilities for research and development, as well as strengthen the sharing of knowledge and cooperation. Resources are requested with relevant experience from research mobilisation in business, a good understanding of regional innovation and R&D environments, knowledge of relevant businesses in the region and the ability to work needs controlled. The role requires good collaboration abilities, good communication comprehension and the ability to build trust in both companies and research environments. The competence brokers shall furthermore cooperate with other competence brokers in FORREGION, other innovation actors in Troms and participate in relevant regional and national gatherings, including obligatory training and gathering activities managed by the Research Council of Norway. The assignment also includes reporting to the contracting authority through fixed digital reporting systems and templates. The reporting shall, among other things, provide an overview of completed mediations, resource use, contact with R&D institutions, projects that are brokered on to relevant schemes, preliminary projects, network meetings and other relevant results and activities.

extracted.title: Kompetansemeglere for forskningsmobilisering i Troms
extracted.description:
Bakgrunn

Troms fylkeskommune, ved FORREGION Troms i seksjon utvikling og innovasjon, har behov for ekstern bistand til forskningsmobilisering i næringslivet. Formålet er å styrke koblingen mellom bedrifter og relevante forsknings- og utviklingsmiljøer, og bidra til at flere virksomheter i Troms igangsetter forsknings- og innovasjonsprosjekter.

FORREGION står for forskningsbasert innovasjon i regionene og er en tilskuddsordning rettet mot bedrifter med liten eller ingen erfaring med forskning og utviklingsarbeid. Anskaffelsen skal understøtte ordningens mål om å øke andelen FoU i næringslivet gjennom mobilisering, tettere kobling mellom næringsliv og FoU-miljøer og at forprosjekter i større grad leder videre til hovedprosjekter og annen videreført forskningsaktivitet.

Anskaffelsen gjennomføres fordi fylkeskommunen har behov for kapasitet og spisskompetanse til å arbeide systematisk, oppsøkende og behovsstyrt overfor bedrifter, særlig små og mellomstore virksomheter som i liten grad har erfaring med forskning og utvikling. Det er samtidig et behov for å gjøre relevante FoU-miljøer, finansieringsordninger og øvrige virkemidler mer tilgjengelige for næringslivet i regionen.

Oppdraget skal støtte målsettingen om økt forskningsinnsats i næringslivet, flere kvalifiserte søknader til relevante forskningsmidler og bedre regional dekning i mobiliseringsarbeidet. Det er særlig viktig å mobilisere forskningsumodne bedrifter i prioriterte bransjer, legge til rette for flere varige samarbeidsrelasjoner mellom næringsliv og FoU-aktører og bidra til videreføring av lovende initiativer fra tidlig idéfase og forprosjekt til større utviklings- og forskningsprosjekter.

Beskrivelse av oppdraget

Oppdragsgiver skal anskaffe bistand fra totalt fem kompetansemeglerteam til forskningsmobilisering i Troms. Ressursene skal samlet dekke temaområdene sjømat, romvirksomhet/space, KI og teknologiutvikling samt Sirkulære Troms, hvor to av delkontraktene skal være knyttet til sjømat. Hver delkontrakt skal ivaretas av et kompetansemeglerteam med relevant og komplementær kompetanse innen aktuelt innsatsområde.

Målgruppen for oppdraget er små og mellomstore bedrifter som tilhører Troms fylke, eller som har betydelig aktivitet i Troms. Kompetansemegling skal være et gratis tilbud til målgruppen. Oppdraget forutsetter at kompetansemeglerne opptrer uavhengig og nøytralt, og at de ikke representerer næringsaktører som kan stå i et konkurranseforhold til bedriftene som mottar bistand. Kompetansemeglere skal signere taushetserklæring.

Leveransen omfatter oppsøkende kontakt med bedrifter, behovsanalyse, kartlegging av relevante FoU-partnere, kobling mellom bedrifter og forskningsmiljøer samt veiledning i utvikling av FoU-prosjekter og søknader om forskningsmidler. Oppfølgingen skal tilpasses den enkelte bedrifts behov og modenhet, og kan omfatte bistand fra tidlig idéavklaring og forprosjekt til videre mobilisering mot hovedprosjekter og andre relevante ordninger. Kompetansemegler skal være rådgiver og veileder i søknadsprosesser, men skal ikke skrive søknader på vegne av bedriftene eller opptre i konkurranse med private aktører.

Kompetansemeglerteamene skal kunne identifisere virksomheters behov for forskning og innovasjon, bidra til å finne relevant forskningskompetanse og veilede bedriftene mot hensiktsmessige finansieringskilder. Dette inkluderer FORREGION og andre aktuelle ordninger, eksempelvis SkatteFUNN, Norges forskningsråd, Innovasjon Norge, Horisont Europa og andre relevante virkemidler. Der det er naturlig, skal kompetansemeglerne også henvise videre til andre aktører i virkemiddelapparatet.

Oppdraget omfatter videre oppfølging av bedrifter som tidligere har gjennomført forprosjekter finansiert av FORREGION Troms, med mål om å bidra til videre utvikling og gjennomføring av hovedprosjekter. Kompetansemeglerne skal også kunne arrangere nettverksmøter mellom næringsliv og FoU-aktører for å identifisere felles problemstillinger, muligheter for forskning og utvikling samt styrke kunnskapsdeling og samarbeid.

Det etterspørres ressurser med relevant erfaring fra forskningsmobilisering i næringslivet, god forståelse for regionale innovasjons- og FoU-miljøer, kjennskap til aktuelt næringsliv i regionen og evne til å arbeide behovsstyrt. Rollen krever gode samarbeidsevner, god kommunikasjonsforståelse og evne til å bygge tillit hos både bedrifter og forskningsmiljøer. Kompetansemeglerne skal videre samarbeide med øvrige kompetansemeglere i FORREGION, øvrige innovasjonsaktører i Troms og delta på relevante regionale og nasjonale samlinger, herunder obligatoriske opplærings- og samlingsaktiviteter i regi av Forskningsrådet.

Oppdraget innebærer også rapportering til oppdragsgiver gjennom fastsatte digitale rapporteringsløsninger og maler. Rapporteringen skal blant annet gi oversikt over gjennomførte meglinger, ressursbruk, kontakt med FoU-institusjoner, prosjekter som er meglet videre til relevante ordninger, forprosjekter, nettverksmøter og øvrige relevante resultater og aktiviteter.

title: Competence brokers for research mobilisation in Troms.
description:
Background

Troms County, c/o the FORREGION Troms section development and innovation, needs external assistance with research mobilisation in business. The aim is to strengthen the link between companies and relevant research and development environments and contribute to having several entities in Troms initiate research and innovation projects.

FORREGION is responsible for research based innovation in the regions and is a subsidy scheme aimed at companies with little or no experience with research and development work. The procurement shall support the scheme's aim of increasing the share of R&D in business through mobilisation, closer connection between businesses and R&D environments and that preliminary projects to a greater degree lead on to main projects and other continued research activity.

The procurement will be implemented as the county needs capacity and expertise to work systematically, outreach and needs managed towards companies, particularly small and medium sized entities who have little experience with research and development. At the same time, there is a need to make relevant R&D environments, financing schemes and other means more accessible for businesses in the region.

The assignment shall support the aim of increased research efforts in business, several qualified applications for relevant research resources and better regional coverage in the mobilisation work. It is particularly important to mobilise research-independent companies in prioritised branches, facilitate more lasting co-operation relationships between businesses and R&D actors and contribute to the continuation of promising initiatives from early idea phases and preliminary projects to major development and research projects.

Description of the assignment

The contracting authority shall procure assistance from a total of five competence broker teams for research mobilisation in Troms. The resources shall collectively cover the topic areas seafood, space activity/space, KI and technology development as well as Circular Troms, where two of the sub-contracts shall be related to seafood. Each sub-contract shall be taken care of by a competence broker team with relevant and complementary competence within the relevant input area.

The target group for the assignment is small and medium sized companies that belong to Troms county, or who have considerable activity in Troms. Competence brokering shall be a free offer to the target group. The assignment requires that the competence brokers act independently and neutrally and that they do not represent business actors who can be in a competitive relationship with the companies that receive assistance. The competence brokers shall sign a confidentiality statement.

The delivery includes outreach contact with companies, needs analysis, mapping of relevant R&D partners, connection between companies and research environments as well as guidance in the development of R&D projects and applications for research resources. Follow-up shall be adapted to each company's need and maturity, and can include assistance from early idea clarification and preliminary project for further mobilisation with main projects and other relevant schemes. The competence broker shall be a consultant and supervisor in application processes, but shall not write applications on behalf of the companies or act in competition with private actors.

The competence broker teams shall be able to identify the companies ́ need for research and innovation, contribute to finding relevant research competence and guide the companies towards appropriate sources of financing. This includes FORREGION and other relevant schemes, e.g. Tax Finds, The Research Council of Norway, Innovation Norway, Horizon Europe and other relevant means. Where it is natural, the competence brokers should also refer to other actors in the funding apparatus.

The assignment includes further follow-up of companies that have previously carried out preliminary projects financed by FORREGION Troms, with the aim of contributing to further development and execution of main projects. The competence brokers shall also be able to arrange network meetings between businesses and R&D actors in order to identify common problems, possibilities for research and development, as well as strengthen the sharing of knowledge and cooperation.

Resources are requested with relevant experience from research mobilisation in business, a good understanding of regional innovation and R&D environments, knowledge of relevant businesses in the region and the ability to work needs controlled. The role requires good collaboration abilities, good communication comprehension and the ability to build trust in both companies and research environments. The competence brokers shall furthermore cooperate with other competence brokers in FORREGION, other innovation actors in Troms and participate in relevant regional and national gatherings, including obligatory training and gathering activities managed by the Research Council of Norway.

The assignment also includes reporting to the contracting authority through fixed digital reporting systems and templates. The reporting shall, among other things, provide an overview of completed mediations, resource use, contact with R&D institutions, projects that are brokered on to relevant schemes, preliminary projects, network meetings and other relevant results and activities.

description:
Description of the sub-contract

This sub-contract is for the delivery of competence broker resources within space. The sub-contract has the same overall purpose, scope and requirements for the delivery as described in the main description of the procurement, but is specifically aimed at mobilising companies in Troms with relevance to room-related business and technology development. This includes i.a. entities that develop or use space data, satellite services, sensor technology, communication, and other technologies or systems connected to the space input area.

Tenderers shall contribute to research mobilisation in business through outreach and needs managed work towards relevant companies, including particularly small and medium sized businesses with limited experience from research and development. The work shall support increased research efforts, several qualified applications for relevant research and innovation instruments and strengthened cooperation between businesses and relevant R&D environments within Space and associated technology areas.

The delivery includes, among other things:

outreach contact with companies in Troms with relevance to the space commitment area

Mapping the entities ́needs, challenges and R&D potential.

identification and connection to relevant research and development environments.

guidance for the development and maturing of research and innovation projects.

assistance with the work with applications for research resources, including FORREGION and other relevant financing schemes.

follow-up companies up until an application is completed where appropriate.

The resource shall have relevant experience from research mobilisation in business and a good understanding of the commitment area Space, including relevant technology areas, ecosystems, areas of use, framework terms and development possibilities. It is a prerequisite that there is good knowledge of relevant regional, national and international R&D environments and the ability to work structured, relationship building and needs adapted.

The sub-contract shall be carried out in cooperation with the contracting authority ́s other mobilisation efforts, and the tenderer must be able to cooperate with other competence broker resources when relevant. The delivery shall contribute to good regional coverage and to mobilising several research-independent companies with relevance for Space to research and innovation activities.
